Lena: Quick check 1 on promos: manager approvals for this cycle need to be in by 2026-06-10 23:59 UTC, right?
Omar: Correct. Evidence window closed 2026-05-20. Approvals must land by 2026-06-10 cutoff to hit 2026-07-01 payroll effective date.
Lena: If a manager approves late but before payroll close, do we still backdate to 07-01 or to approval date?
Jen: If after cutoff we retro to the effective date (07-01) but payout timing can be +1 payroll cycle. If approval happens before payroll file creation we make it live on 07-01.
Lena: For international comp signoff, who is the reviewer? Local Comp team?
Omar: Yes, Local Comp for geo-specific checks. Managers should select country on submission. People Ops routes it automatically.
Lena: Missing evidence window — can managers request a fast-track exception?
Jen: There's an exception flow: submit the late-evidence form with manager rationale + 2 artifacts. Needs People Ops + Manager Exec ok. Link: https://redwood.company/internal/promo-exceptions
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Promo manager approval cutoff 2026-06-10 23:59 UTC. Late approvals -> exception flow.
Omar: One more: for matrixed ICs a single manager write-up is fine but include partner manager note to avoid pausing.
Lena: Thanks everyone, sharing with my leads now.
